description: Returns available affected body part options for use in injury record forms. Each option contains a label for display and a value to submit when creating or updating injuries.

label.description: Human-readable display name for the affected body part (e.g. 'Finger index'). Use in UI dropdowns and form labels.

value.description: Server-side value to submit when creating or updating an injury record's affected body part (e.g. 'finger_index').
